calendar.subhead: A care coordinator will go over your loved one's needs, answer your questions, and explain how care would work.

thankYou.title: You're Booked. Here's What Happens Next.
thankYou.subhead: Your care assessment is on the calendar. We'll be in touch before it to confirm.
steps: Look out for a confirmation text and email from Home Care Aide Services.
If someone else helps make care decisions - a sibling, a spouse - invite them to join.
Jot down your loved one's daily routine, medications and anything that worries you, so nothing gets missed.

copy.disclaimer: By continuing you agree to be contacted by Home Care Aide Services by phone, text or email about your care request. Consent is not a condition of service. Message and data rates may apply; reply STOP to opt out.

body: Home Care Aide Services provides in-home care in Sonoma and Marin County, California, so we can't send a caregiver to where your loved one lives.
Your local Area Agency on Aging can point you to trusted care nearby. Find yours at eldercare.acl.gov.
